channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Indian Doctor’s Free Miracle Surgeries Straighten Pakistani Afsheen Gul’s 90° Twisted Neck After 12 Years
item.description: A Pakistani teen from Sindh walks freely today after Indian doctors' free, complex surgeries fixed her decade-long 90-degree neck twist in 2022.

item.title: Madras High Court Suggests Centre to Consider Australia-Style Social Media Ban for Children Under 16
item.description: Madras High Court urges the Indian government to consider an Australia-style social media ban for children under 16.

item.title: ‘Papa, I Cannot Bear the Pain’: Indian-Origin Man Dies After Alleged 8-Hour Emergency Room Wait in Canada, Probe Launched
item.description: An Indian-origin man’s death following an alleged prolonged emergency room wait has reignited debate over delays, accountability and patient safety in Canada’s strained public healthcare system.

item.title: Is Bajaj Life’s NRI Plan a Good Option for Cross-Border Family Security?
item.description: Bajaj Life's NRI Plan offers NRIs tailored life coverage, death benefits, and investment options to protect dependents in India seamlessly from overseas.

item.title: People of Purpose: How EcoSoul Is Turning India’s Sustainable Alternatives into Global Sustainable Solutions
item.description: Three professionals transform India's agro-waste into affordable, global sustainable home essentials, empowering rural women while outpacing China in the fight against single-use plastics.

item.title: Bangladesh: James Show Called Off After Attackers Hurl Bricks at Faridpur Concert Venue, Several Students Injured
item.description: Bangladesh icon James concert called off after mob hurled bricks, stones at concert in Faridpur.

item.title: Mizoram’s 9-Year-Old Esther Shines at Rashtrapati Bhavan with Pradhan Mantri Bal Puraskar
item.description: A 9-year-old singing sensation from Mizoram's Lunglei receives India's top child award for her viral patriotic renditions that united millions.

item.title: 10-Year-Old Shravan Cycles Milk, Lassi to Army Jawans in Op Sindoor, Bags PM Rashtriya Bal Puraskar Honour
item.description: A 10-year-old Sikh boy from a Punjab border village won India's top child bravery award for fearlessly supplying refreshments to soldiers during tense India-Pakistan operations.

item.title: ‘I Froze, Then Slapped Him’: Bengaluru Woman’s Metro Nightmare Exposes Police Sympathy
item.description: Bengaluru woman slaps drunken Namma Metro molester; police issue NCR warning, sparking leniency fury.

item.title: CBI Files Supreme Court Petition Challenging Delhi High Court Bail for Unnao Rape Convict Kuldeep Singh Sengar
item.description: CBI challenges Supreme Court Delhi High Court suspension of Sengar's life sentence in 2017 Unnao rape case amid protests.
